report.scene: A camera photo of a computer monitor showing a desktop with a space wallpaper of a planet and a bright star, with rows of icons along the top and bottom.

differing_details: The photo shows a computer monitor, not a power bank.
No black rectangular power bank with 20W printed on the front is visible anywhere in the photo.
No Model: W5 PRO marking is visible.
product.reason_plain: No. The photo shows a computer monitor, not the recalled HAIARA power bank.
product.reason_technical: The only object is a widescreen monitor with a glossy black bezel, an HDMI label at the lower left and a desktop with icons. Its shape, size and features do not match the small black rectangular power bank with 20W text or a charging ring shown in the official images. The screen does not show the product either.

actions.evidence: No power bank is visible, and no handwritten word recalled appears anywhere in the photo, on the monitor or on its screen.

photo_source.reason: The photo shows a physical monitor with its bezel, a glossy reflective surface and a computer desktop with icons and a taskbar on the screen. The screen shows a wallpaper, not the product.

report.retake_tip: Please take a photo of the power bank itself, in good light, with the word recalled written on it in permanent marker.
